mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in FEDFUNDS predicts negative 20-day S&P 500 returns due to increased discount rates compressing equity valuations.
failure_condition: 20-day returns in tightening periods not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or FEDFUNDS trend reverses before returns occur.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in UNRATE below 4.0% triggers positive 20-day S&P 500 returns as labor market tightness signals stronger growth.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) during UNRATE drops below 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rise in GDPC1 (demand) above 250 and INDPRO (supply) above 105 triggers positive 60-day S&P 500 returns as balanced growth signals expansion.
failure_condition: 60-day returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) during simultaneous GDPC1 and INDPRO exceedances.

mechanism_narrative: Concomitant rise in FEDFUNDS and fall in UNRATE signals tightening monetary policy and labor market strength, driving positive 5-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 5-day returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) during FEDFUNDS up and UNRATE down periods.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion, a sustained FEDFUNDS decline below 4.5% triggers positive 20-day S&P 500 returns as policy easing supports growth.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS falls below 4.5% in late-cycle expansion
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) during FEDFUNDS below 4.5% in late-cycle expansion.

mechanism_narrative: In post-shock recovery, a UNRATE drop below 3.5% triggers positive 60-day S&P 500 returns as labor market recovery accelerates.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls below 3.5% in post-shock recovery
failure_condition: 60-day returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) during UNRATE below 3.5% in post-shock recovery.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous UNRATE below 3.5% and HOUST above 1400 triggers positive 5-day S&P 500 returns as labor market recovery and demand growth align.
failure_condition: 5-day returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) during UNRATE < 3.5% and HOUST > 1400.

mechanism_narrative: In recessionary environments, RSAFS below 600 million triggers negative 60-day S&P 500 returns as weak demand signals contraction.
failure_condition: 60-day returns not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) during RSAFS below 600 in recessionary environments.
